arabic text:
BY THE STARS AND HOW THEY ARE FIXED, UNLIKE THE TEARS WE CRY
WE'LL CONTINUE TO LAMENT HIM, LONG AFTER WE ALL DIE
DEVOID OF ALL OUR WORRIES, THE ASHES FROM OUR BODIES
SHALL ALL RECITE THE MELODIES, OF HUSSAIN'S TRAGEDIES
english translation text:
By the stars and how they remain fixed, unlike the tears we shed,
we will continue to lament him long after all of us have died.
Freed from every worry, the ashes of our bodies
will recite the melodies of Hussain's tragedies.

arabic text:
HUSSAIN'S DAY IS NOT A DAY, HIS DAY MAKES THE YEAR SWAY
AND IF LOVE CAN TAKE AWAY BREATH, HIS LOVE TAKES SOULS AWAY
THE WHOLE WORLD WE CAN FORGET, YET OUR EYES SHALL REMAIN
WET
THE WHOLE WORLD CAN END AND YET, HIS SUN SHALL NEVER SET
english translation text:
Hussain's day is not merely a day; his day causes
the entire year to sway. And if love can take
away breath, his love takes souls away. We may forget
the whole world, yet our eyes will remain wet; the
world itself may end, but his sun will never set.

arabic text:
DROWNING WE WERE SAVED BY HIM, OUR ARK OF SALVATION
GOD PLACED TEARS OF HUSSAIN, WITHIN OUR CREATION
AND SO TOWARDS HIM WE'RE DRAWN, HIS DOME UPON OUR EYES
DRAWN
THE LORD HAD CREATED THE DAWN, SO THAT FOR HIM WE MOURN
english translation text:
We were drowning, and he saved us—our Ark
of Salvation. God placed tears for Hussain within
our very creation. Thus we are drawn towards him,
his dome engraved upon our eyes; the Lord
created dawn so that we may mourn for him.

arabic text:
WE WON'T FORGET HUSSAIN'S WOUNDS, THE SEVENTEEN HUNDRED
NOR SHALL HIS SEVENTY TWO, BE LOST FOR A SECOND
AND THE SIX MONTH OLD INFANT, AND THE SCORCHED AND THE
BURNING TENTS
AGAINST THE FACE OF TYRANTS, FOR THEM ALL WE LAMENT
english translation text:
We will never forget Hussain's seventeen hundred wounds,
nor will his seventy-two be forgotten for even
a moment. Nor the six-month-old infant, nor
the scorched and burning tents; in the face
of tyranny, we lament for them all.

arabic text:
IF OUR LEGS WERE TAKEN AWAY, TO YOUR GRAVE WE WOULD CRAWL
YOUR GRAVE BECAME A KA'BA, THAT EVEN THE STARS CIRCLE
THE WOUNDS FROM WHICH YOUR WOULD ACHE, A HOUSE OF GOD THEY
WOULD MAKE
FOR GOD'S PLEASURE AND YOUR SAKE, WE'D COME CRYING LABBAYK
english translation text:
If our legs were taken away, we would crawl towards
your grave. Your grave became a Kaaba around which even
the stars circle. From the wounds that caused your body
pain, we would build a house of God; for God's
pleasure and for your sake, we would come crying 'Labbayk'.

arabic text:
A PROMISE TO YOUR MOTHER, AND TO HER RIB BROKEN
WE'LL REMEMBER TILL THE EARTH, BY THIS LOVE IS SHAKEN
ONE DAY BESIDE HER LAST SON, MEHDI THE AWAITED ONE
WE SHALL MOURN HER MARTYRED SON, THAT FROM OUR SKIES IS GONE
english translation text:
A promise to your mother and to her broken rib:
we will remember until the earth itself shakes through this love.
One day, beside her final son—the awaited Mahdi—
we will mourn her martyred son who disappeared from our skies.
